items.title: Baranowski a Butkus Award Semifinalist
items.summary: Minnesota fifth-year senior Maverick Baranowski has been named one of 15 semifinalists for the Butkus Award, given annually to the nation's top linebacker.

items.title: Game 8 Preview: Minnesota at Indiana
items.summary: Meeting for the first time since 2021, RV/RV Minnesota visits defending national champion No. 4/4 Indiana Saturday. Kickoff is set for 2:30 p.m. on CBS and the Gopher Radio Network. The game will also be the site of ESPN's College Gameday, marking the third time Minnesota has been a part of the show (Michigan in 2020, Wisconsin in 2019).
